## Changelog

- Updated both regions to official 1.0.3 resources and fixed extraction of the changed installer format.
- Translated the bundled interface, native prompts and documentation into English.
- Added configurable global shortcuts with Mac modifier labels, capture and persistence.
- Pointed project, issue and Mac download links to this project.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.
- Choose the `CN` package for a mainland China account or `Global` for a Global account.
- Quit the existing app, then drag the app from the DMG into Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app there.
- If macOS blocks launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- Enable Input Monitoring in System Settings → Privacy & Security for keyboard and mouse counting.
